column5: 编辑器能保留字幕时间信息进行导入吗？

column2: Let me download the original image, not just the preview.
column3: 让我下载原图，而不只是预览图。
column4: The download should include the subtitle file as well.
column5: 下载内容也应该包含字幕文件。

column2: Please save the prompt before starting another generation.
column3: 开始另一次生成前，请先保存提示词。
column4: Can I save this voice setting for the next episode?
column5: 我能保存这个声音设置，用于下一集吗？

column2: Use undo to bring back the deleted title.
column3: 使用撤销功能恢复删掉的标题。
column4: Can I undo this crop after closing the image editor?
column5: 关闭图像编辑器后，我还能撤销这次裁剪吗？

column2: The reset button clears the style settings.
column3: 重置按钮会清除风格设置。
column4: Do not reset the scene until we have saved a copy.
column5: 保存副本前，不要重置这个场景。

column2: Can you duplicate this scene and change only the background?
column3: 能复制这个场景，只修改背景吗？
column4: I want to duplicate the project before testing a different voice.
column5: 我想先复制项目，再试另一个声音。

column2: Make a copy of the prompt that produced this result.
column3: 复制一份生成这个结果所用的提示词。
column4: Can I copy the subtitle style to the next clip?
column5: 我能把字幕样式复制到下一个片段吗？

column2: Please paste the corrected caption into the text field.
column3: 请把修改后的配文粘贴到文本框里。
column4: When I paste the script, the paragraph breaks disappear.
column5: 我粘贴剧本时，分段消失了。

column2: Do not delete the original recording after generating the voice track.
column3: 生成配音后，不要删掉原始录音。
column4: Can users delete an uploaded image from their account?
column5: 用户能从账户中删除已上传的图片吗？

column2: Please remove the watermark from our own draft overlay.
column3: 请移除我们自己加在草稿上的水印图层。
column4: We need to remove the empty space at the start of the clip.
column5: 我们需要移除片段开头的空白部分。

column2: Can you replace the background without changing the character?
column3: 能替换背景而不改变角色吗？
column4: Please replace this temporary music with the approved track.
column5: 请把这段临时音乐替换成已确认可用的曲目。

column2: Rename the exports so the scene numbers come first.
column3: 重命名导出文件，让场景编号排在最前面。
column4: Can I rename an asset without breaking its links in the timeline?
column5: 我重命名素材后，它在时间线中的链接还能保持正常吗？

column2: Select the face before applying the correction.
column3: 应用修正前，先选中脸部。
column4: Can I select several clips and lower their volume together?
column5: 我能选择多个片段，同时降低它们的音量吗？

column2: The selection includes part of the background.
column3: 这个选区包含了一部分背景。
column4: Expand the selection slightly so the edge blends better.
column5: 稍微扩大选区，让边缘融合得更自然。

column2: The preview looks sharp, but the export looks blurry.
column3: 预览很清晰，但导出结果看起来模糊。
column4: Show a preview before charging for the full render.
column5: 对完整渲染收费前，先展示预览。

column2: Playback stops halfway through the second scene.
column3: 播放到第二个场景的一半时就停了。
column4: Check playback with headphones before approving the voice mix.
column5: 确认人声混音前，戴耳机播放检查一下。

column2: The player should let me jump back five seconds.
column3: 播放器应该让我能往回跳五秒。
column4: This player shows subtitles, but it cannot switch audio tracks.
column5: 这个播放器能显示字幕，但不能切换音轨。

column2: Add a short pause before the final line.
column3: 最后一句台词前加一个短暂停顿。
column4: Can I pause the preview without stopping the render?
column5: 我能暂停预览，而不停止渲染吗？

column2: Click play to resume the video from this frame.
column3: 点击播放，从这一帧继续播放视频。
column4: The player should resume where I left off.
column5: 播放器应该从我上次停下的位置继续播放。

column2: Put the short animation on a loop while we discuss it.
column3: 我们讨论时，让这段短动画循环播放。
column4: The loop has a visible jump between the last and first frames.
column5: 这个循环的末帧和首帧之间有明显跳变。

column2: Could you repeat that line with a softer voice?
column3: 能用更柔和的声音再说一遍那句台词吗？
column4: The clip is set to repeat until the reviewer stops it.
column5: 这个片段设成了重复播放，直到审看者停止它。

column2: Lower the playback speed so we can inspect the hand movement.
column3: 降低播放速度，方便我们检查手部动作。
column4: At normal speed, the transition looks much smoother.
column5: 以正常速度播放时，这个转场看起来顺畅得多。

column2: The total duration is longer than the brief allows.
column3: 总时长超过了需求说明规定的长度。
column4: Show the duration of each clip next to its thumbnail.
column5: 在每个片段的缩略图旁显示时长。

column2: Reduce the length of the opening shot by two seconds.
column3: 把开场镜头缩短两秒。
column4: What is the maximum clip length for this export format?
column5: 这种导出格式允许的最大片段长度是多少？

column2: The lip movements are out of sync with the voice.
column3: 嘴唇动作与人声不同步。
column4: Can you sync the subtitle timing with the revised recording?
column5: 能把字幕时间调整到与修改后的录音同步吗？

column2: Audio synchronization is off after the frame-rate change.
column3: 修改帧率后，音频同步出现了偏差。
column4: Check synchronization at both the start and end of the video.
column5: 在视频开头和结尾都检查一下同步情况。

column2: We need to synchronize the captions with the final voice track.
column3: 我们需要让字幕与最终配音同步。
column4: Can this editor synchronize footage from both cameras?
column5: 这个编辑器能同步两台摄像机的素材吗？

column2: This synchronous call waits for the result before returning.
column3: 这个同步调用会等待结果后再返回。
column4: A long synchronous operation freezes the preview in our current app.
column5: 在我们当前的应用中，耗时较长的同步操作会让预览卡住。

column2: The two clips are rendering in parallel.
column3: 这两个片段正在并行渲染。
column4: Can the workflow run image generation and audio cleanup in parallel?
column5: 这个工作流能并行执行图像生成和音频清理吗？

column2: The video is still in the generation queue.
column3: 这段视频还在生成队列里。
column4: Show the queue position so creators know their job is waiting.
column5: 显示排队位置，让创作者知道任务正在等待。

column2: This job failed before it generated any frames.
column3: 这个任务还没生成任何帧就失败了。
column4: Keep the job ID so we can find the result later.
column5: 保留任务编号，方便以后找到结果。

column2: The next task is to check the character's hands.
column3: 下一个任务是检查角色的手部。
column4: Assign the subtitle task to someone who can review both languages.
column5: 把字幕任务交给能审校两种语言的人。

column2: The status still says rendering, but the video is ready.
column3: 视频已经完成，但状态仍显示正在渲染。
column4: Can the status page explain why this job stopped?
column5: 状态页面能说明这个任务为什么停止吗？

column2: The progress bar has not moved for several minutes.
column3: 进度条已经好几分钟没动了。
column4: Show progress separately for upload and rendering.
column5: 把上传进度和渲染进度分开显示。

column2: The pending jobs will start when a worker becomes available.
column3: 有空闲工作进程时，待处理任务就会开始。
column4: This image is still pending review, so do not publish it yet.
column5: 这张图仍在等待审核，先不要发布。

column2: Can you complete the sound check before the review meeting?
column3: 能在审看会议前完成声音检查吗？
column4: The export is complete, but we still need to watch the whole video.
column5: 导出已经完成，但我们还需要完整看一遍视频。

column2: The render failure happened during the final scene.
column3: 渲染失败发生在最后一个场景。
column4: Record the failure message before trying the job again.
column5: 重试任务前，先记录失败信息。

column2: The error message does not say which file is missing.
column3: 错误信息没有说明缺少哪个文件。
column4: This spelling error appears in every generated caption.
column5: 这个拼写错误出现在每条生成的配文里。

column2: Can I cancel the queued job before it starts?
column3: 我能在排队任务开始前取消它吗？
column4: Please cancel this export; it uses the old voice track.
column5: 请取消这次导出，它用的是旧配音。

column2: The account has no image-generation quota left today.
column3: 这个账户今天的图像生成额度用完了。
column4: Check the quota before submitting all the scenes at once.
column5: 一次提交所有场景前，先检查额度。

column2: The upload limit is too low for this reference video.
column3: 上传限制太低，这段参考视频传不上去。
column4: Can we set a spending limit for each project?
column5: 我们能为每个项目设置支出上限吗？

column2: The usage page separates image jobs from video jobs.
column3: 用量页面把图像任务与视频任务分开统计。
column4: Check yesterday's usage before estimating this week's cost.
column5: 估算本周费用前，先看看昨天的用量。

column2: The test image used one credit from the account.
column3: 这张测试图消耗了账户里的一个生成点数。
column4: Give the photographer credit in the end titles.
column5: 在片尾字幕中为摄影师署名。

column2: Does this subscription include high-resolution downloads?
column3: 这个订阅包含高分辨率下载吗？
column4: Check the renewal date before changing the subscription.
column5: 修改订阅前，先检查续订日期。

column2: The billing page should show the cost of each generation.
column3: 计费页面应该显示每次生成的费用。
column4: Who handles billing for the team's shared account?
column5: 谁负责团队共用账户的计费事务？

column2: What is the cost of generating a ten-second clip?
column3: 生成一段十秒的视频要多少钱？
column4: Include failed attempts when calculating the total production cost.
column5: 计算总制作成本时，也要计入失败尝试的费用。

column2: We have enough budget for one more version of the scene.
column3: 我们的预算还够再做一个版本的场景。
column4: Leave some budget for captions and sound editing.
column5: 留一些预算给字幕和声音剪辑。

column2: Can you estimate the cost before we start the batch?
column3: 开始批量生成前，能估算一下费用吗？
column4: This estimate does not include another round of revisions.
column5: 这份估算没有包括再修改一轮的费用。

column2: Do we have permission to use this recording in the trailer?
column3: 我们获得了在预告片中使用这段录音的许可吗？
column4: The app asks for permission before accessing my photo folder.
column5: 应用访问我的照片文件夹前，会先请求权限。

column2: Keep the written authorization with the project files.
column3: 把书面授权和项目文件放在一起保存。
column4: We need authorization from the speaker before cloning this voice.
column5: 克隆这个声音前，我们需要取得说话者的授权。

column2: The contract should explain ownership of the commissioned artwork.
column3: 合同应该说明委托创作作品的所有权。
column4: Ask about ownership before handing over the source files.
column5: 交付源文件前，先问清楚所有权问题。

column2: Who is the owner of the original recording?
column3: 原始录音的权利人是谁？
column4: Contact the rights owner before reusing this song.
column5: 再次使用这首歌前，先联系权利人。

column2: The notes explain how AI was used during the creation of the animation.
column3: 这些记录说明了动画创作过程中如何使用AI。
column4: The tutorial walks through the creation of a short animated scene.
column5: 这份教程逐步介绍一个短动画场景的创作过程。

column2: The client wants an original character rather than a familiar movie hero.
column3: 客户想要一个原创角色，而不是大家熟悉的电影英雄。
column4: Keep the original sketch so the illustrator can compare the changes.
column5: 保留原始草图，方便插画师对比修改内容。

column2: The review checks originality as well as visual quality.
column3: 这次审看既检查原创性，也检查视觉质量。
column4: A new file name tells us nothing about the image's originality.
column5: 一个新的文件名并不能说明图片有原创性。

column2: We need to ask whether the license allows a derivative work.
column3: 我们需要询问该许可是否允许创作衍生作品。
column4: This derivative illustration uses elements from the earlier poster.
column5: 这幅衍生插画使用了之前海报中的元素。

column2: Does the music agreement include a royalty payment?
column3: 音乐协议包含版税支付吗？
column4: The royalty report lists the videos that used the track.
column5: 版税报告列出了使用这首曲目的视频。

column2: Check the license before using the image in a commercial campaign.
column3: 把图片用于商业宣传前，先检查许可。
column4: The brief says this video is for commercial use.
column5: 需求说明写明，这段视频将用于商业用途。

column2: The team is discussing commercialization of its animation tool.
column3: 团队正在讨论动画工具的商业化。
column4: We need a support plan before commercialization begins.
column5: 开始商业化前，我们需要制定支持服务方案。

column2: This project is a noncommercial student exhibition.
column3: 这个项目是一次非商业的学生作品展。
column4: The client asked whether the recording permits noncommercial use.
column5: 客户询问这段录音是否允许非商业使用。

column2: The review flagged a possible copyright infringement for further checking.
column3: 审核标记了一项可能的版权侵权问题，留待进一步核查。
column4: Send the infringement complaint to the person handling rights requests.
column5: 把侵权投诉转给负责权利相关请求的人。

column2: The editor raised a plagiarism concern about the opening paragraph.
column3: 编辑对开头一段提出了抄袭疑虑。
column4: We review plagiarism reports against the original sources.
column5: 我们会把抄袭报告与原始来源对照检查。

column2: The image contains a trademark that was not in our prompt.
column3: 图片里出现了提示词中没有的商标。
column4: Ask the client whether the trademark should appear in this scene.
column5: 问问客户，这个场景中是否应出现该商标。

column2: Keep the image's provenance record with the final export.
column3: 把图像的来源记录与最终导出文件一起保存。
column4: The provenance record includes the source file and editing history.
column5: 来源记录包含源文件和编辑历史。

column2: Add a short disclosure about the synthetic voice.
column3: 加一段简短说明，披露使用了合成声音。
column4: Place the disclosure where viewers can actually read it.
column5: 把披露说明放在观众能看清的位置。

column2: We should be transparent about which scenes were AI-generated.
column3: 我们应该明确说明哪些场景由AI生成。
column4: The report is transparent about the tests we have not completed.
column5: 报告如实说明了哪些测试尚未完成。

column2: The client asked for more transparency about the image sources.
column3: 客户要求更清楚地公开图片来源。
column4: This log improves transparency by recording changes to the draft.
column5: 这份日志通过记录草稿修改，提高了过程的透明度。

column2: We discussed the ethical issues before making a synthetic presenter.
column3: 制作合成主持人前，我们讨论了相关伦理问题。
column4: Is it ethical to imitate this person's voice without asking them?
column5: 没有询问本人就模仿其声音，符合伦理吗？

column2: The team has a meeting about the ethics of voice cloning.
column3: 团队会开会讨论声音克隆的伦理问题。
column4: Include ethics in the training for new content reviewers.
column5: 在新内容审核员的培训中加入伦理相关内容。

column2: Content safety is part of the review before publication.
column3: 发布前的审核包含内容安全检查。
column4: The safety check flagged a violent image in the draft.
column5: 安全检查标记了草稿中的一张暴力图像。

column2: The moderation team reviews images reported by users.
column3: 内容审核团队会检查用户举报的图片。
column4: Show a clear message when moderation blocks a generation request.
column5: 内容审核拦截生成请求时，要显示明确的信息。

column2: Read the platform's policy on synthetic media before uploading.
column3: 上传前，先阅读平台的合成媒体政策。
column4: Our policy asks reviewers to check the source of every music track.
column5: 我们的规定要求审核员检查每首音乐的来源。

column2: The compliance review covers the licenses for the stock footage.
column3: 合规审核会检查素材视频的使用许可。
column4: Send the release draft to the compliance team for review.
column5: 把发布稿送给合规团队审核。

column2: Check whether the license has a restriction on editing the image.
column3: 检查许可是否限制修改图片。
column4: The restriction prevents this account from exporting long videos.
column5: 这项限制让这个账户无法导出长视频。

column2: Do not include sensitive client information in the prompt.
column3: 不要在提示词中加入敏感的客户信息。
column4: The reviewer marked this scene as sensitive content.
column5: 审核员把这个场景标记为敏感内容。

column2: The unreleased script is confidential.
column3: 尚未发布的剧本需要保密。
column4: Use a tool approved for confidential material when reviewing this footage.
column5: 审看这段视频时，使用获准处理保密资料的工具。

column2: Remove personal details from the sample interview.
column3: 从示例采访中移除个人信息。
column4: Does the upload contain anyone's personal contact information?
column5: 上传内容里是否包含任何人的个人联系方式？

column2: We need to check the authenticity of this interview recording.
column3: 我们需要核查这份采访录音的真实性。
column4: The label should not imply authenticity when the image is synthetic.
column5: 图像是合成的，标注就不应暗示它是真实影像。

column2: The report describes a possible impersonation of a real presenter.
column3: 报告描述了一起可能冒充真实主持人的情况。
column4: Check the platform's impersonation rules before publishing this avatar.
column5: 发布这个虚拟形象前，先检查平台有关冒充他人的规则。

column2: The account was reported for suspected fraud.
column3: 这个账户因涉嫌欺诈被举报了。
column4: Our review looks for fraud involving fake endorsements.
column5: 我们的审核会排查利用虚假代言进行欺诈的情况。

column2: The title is misleading because the scene never happens in the video.
column3: 标题有误导性，因为视频里根本没有出现那个场景。
column4: Do not present a synthetic interview as real; that would be misleading.
column5: 不要把合成采访当作真实采访呈现，那会误导观众。

column2: The caption repeats misinformation about the event.
column3: 配文重复了有关该事件的错误信息。
column4: Check the original report before sharing possible misinformation.
column5: 分享可能有误的信息前，先核对原始报道。

column2: Source verification is still pending for this quote.
column3: 这句话的来源仍有待核验。
column4: Keep a record of the verification steps for the reviewer.
column5: 记录核验步骤，供审核员查看。

column2: Please verify the speaker's name against the original recording.
column3: 请对照原始录音核实说话者的姓名。
column4: We should verify this date before adding it to the caption.
column5: 把这个日期写进配文前，我们应该先核实。

column2: Treat the generated claim as something to check, not as a confirmed fact.
column3: 把模型生成的说法当作待核查的内容，而不是已确认的事实。
column4: This fact comes from the interview, so keep the recording link.
column5: 这个事实来自采访，因此要保留录音链接。

column2: The citation points to a page that does not support the claim.
column3: 这条引用指向的页面并不能支持该说法。
column4: Add a citation next to the statistic in the script.
column5: 在剧本中的统计数字旁加上引用标注。

column2: What is the source of this background music?
column3: 这段背景音乐的来源是什么？
column4: Keep the source link when you save the reference image.
column5: 保存参考图时，保留来源链接。

column2: We do not have enough evidence to include that claim in the video.
column3: 我们的证据不足，不能把那项说法写进视频。
column4: Save the evidence used to check the quotation.
column5: 保存用于核查引文的证据。

column2: An invented quote would damage the channel's credibility.
column3: 编造引文会损害频道的可信度。
column4: The editor questioned the credibility of this anonymous source.
column5: 编辑对这个匿名来源的可信度提出了质疑。

column2: We need a credible source for the numbers in this chart.
column3: 这张图表里的数字需要有可信的来源。
column4: The interview is useful, but we should check whether the claim is credible.
column5: 采访有参考价值，但我们应该核查那项说法是否可信。

column2: The editor wants a shorter opening shot.
column3: 剪辑师想把开场镜头缩短一些。
column4: Ask the editor to check the captions against the recording.
column5: 请编辑对照录音检查字幕。

column2: The producer is coordinating the shoot and the review schedule.
column3: 制片人在协调拍摄和审看日程。
column4: Tell the producer if another revision will affect the budget.
column5: 如果再修改一轮会影响预算，就告诉制片人。

column2: Production starts after the script and character designs are approved.
column3: 剧本和角色设计确认后，就开始制作。
column4: Keep the reference images available throughout production.
column5: 整个制作过程中都要能随时查看参考图。

column2: The director asked for a longer pause before the reply.
column3: 导演要求在回答前多停顿一会儿。
column4: Show the director both versions of the camera movement.
column5: 把两个版本的镜头运动都给导演看。

column2: The cinematographer wants softer light on the actor's face.
column3: 摄影指导想让演员脸上的光更柔和。
column4: Discuss the reference shots with the cinematographer before filming.
column5: 拍摄前，和摄影指导讨论参考镜头。

column2: The photographer supplied a higher-resolution product image.
column3: 摄影师提供了一张分辨率更高的产品图。
column4: Ask the photographer which photo best matches the lighting in this scene.
column5: 问问摄影师，哪张照片最符合这个场景的光线。

column2: The brief calls for product photography with a plain background.
column3: 需求说明要求用纯色背景拍摄产品照片。
column4: Her photography portfolio helped us choose a visual direction.
column5: 她的摄影作品集帮助我们确定了视觉方向。

column2: The animator noticed that the feet slide across the floor.
column3: 动画师发现角色的脚在地板上滑动。
column4: Give the animator a clear reference for the character's walk.
column5: 给动画师一份清楚展示角色走路动作的参考。

column2: The illustrator needs the character's final costume design.
column3: 插画师需要角色的最终服装设计。
column4: Let the illustrator know which details must stay consistent.
column5: 告诉插画师，哪些细节必须保持一致。

column2: The artist drew three rough versions of the city skyline.
column3: 美术师画了三版城市天际线草图。
column4: We should ask the artist before altering the commissioned painting.
column5: 修改委托创作的画作前，我们应该先询问艺术家。

column2: The writer changed the ending to make the character's choice clearer.
column3: 作者修改了结尾，让角色的选择更清楚。
column4: Send the interview notes to the writer before drafting the narration.
column5: 起草旁白前，把采访记录发给作者。

column2: The screenwriter added a quiet scene between the two arguments.
column3: 编剧在两场争执之间加了一个安静的场景。
column4: Ask the screenwriter whether this line fits the character's background.
column5: 问问编剧，这句台词是否符合角色的背景。

column2: The composer wrote a shorter theme for the opening titles.
column3: 作曲家为片头写了一段更短的主题音乐。
column4: Give the composer the final scene timing before requesting new music.
column5: 请作曲家写新音乐前，先把最终场景时长给他。

column2: The musician recorded another take with a slower tempo.
column3: 音乐人用更慢的速度又录了一遍。
column4: Ask the musician which instrument should lead in this section.
column5: 问问音乐人，这一段应该由哪种乐器主奏。

column2: The performer needs space to finish the gesture before the cut.
column3: 剪切前，需要给表演者留出时间完成动作。
column4: Show the performer the reference movement before recording.
column5: 录制前，先把参考动作给表演者看。

column2: The actor wants to hear the previous line before recording the reply.
column3: 录制回应的台词前，演员想先听一下上一句。
column4: We need the actor's approval before using a synthetic version of their voice.
column5: 使用演员声音的合成版本前，我们需要获得演员的同意。

column2: The actress asked why her character left the room.
column3: 女演员问，她的角色为什么离开房间。
column4: We need the actress to record one more line.
column5: 我们需要这位女演员再录一句台词。

column2: The narrator should pause before revealing the answer.
column3: 旁白者应该在揭晓答案前停顿一下。
column4: Can the narrator speak more quietly in this scene?
column5: 这个场景里，旁白者能说得更轻一些吗？

column2: The speaker is distorting at this volume.
column3: 扬声器在这个音量下出现失真。
column4: The transcript needs a label for each speaker.
column5: 转写稿需要为每位说话者标注身份。

column2: The presenter needs a shorter introduction.
column3: 主持人需要一段更短的开场介绍。
column4: Send the presenter a copy of the final questions.
column5: 把最终版问题发一份给主持人。

column2: The host will introduce the guest before the demo.
column3: 主持人会在演示前介绍嘉宾。
column4: Can the host repeat the question for people watching the replay?
column5: 主持人能把问题重复一遍，方便看回放的人吗？

column2: The cast list is missing the voice actor.
column3: 演员名单里漏了配音演员。
column4: Let's confirm the cast before preparing the recording schedule.
column5: 准备录制日程前，先确认演员阵容。

column2: The collaboration worked better once we agreed on a shared brief.
column3: 统一需求说明后，协作更顺畅了。
column4: This collaboration includes writing, animation, and sound design.
column5: 这次协作涵盖写作、动画和声音设计。

column2: We can collaborate on the storyboard before generating any images.
column3: 生成图片前，我们可以一起设计分镜。
column4: How will the two editors collaborate without overwriting each other's work?
column5: 两位编辑怎样协作，才能不覆盖对方的工作？

column2: Ask the collaborator which files they need for the edit.
column3: 问问合作者，剪辑需要哪些文件。
column4: Our collaborator noticed a continuity error in the draft.
column5: 我们的合作者发现草稿里有一处连续性错误。

column2: The team needs to see the reference clip before editing.
column3: 剪辑前，团队需要看参考短片。
column4: Who on the team is checking the final subtitles?
column5: 团队里由谁检查最终字幕？

column2: The brief doesn't explain who the video is for.
column3: 需求说明没有解释视频是给谁看的。
column4: Let's add the required dimensions to the brief.
column5: 我们把要求的尺寸加进需求说明吧。

column2: The client added a requirement for bilingual captions.
column3: 客户新增了双语字幕的要求。
column4: Is the vertical format a requirement or a preference?
column5: 竖屏格式是硬性要求，还是偏好？

column2: The export specification includes resolution and frame rate.
column3: 导出规格包括分辨率和帧率。
column4: Check the specification before rendering the whole sequence.
column5: 渲染整段序列之前，先核对规格。

column2: The delivery includes the video and the editable project files.
column3: 交付内容包括视频和可编辑项目文件。
column4: We need to agree on a delivery date with the client.
column5: 我们需要与客户商定交付日期。

column2: We're waiting for approval of the character design.
column3: 我们正在等待角色设计获批。
column4: The approval email refers to an older version of the storyboard.
column5: 批准邮件指的是较旧版本的分镜。

column2: Can you approve the final voiceover before we animate the scene?
column3: 给场景做动画之前，你能批准最终旁白吗？
column4: The client needs to approve the logo placement.
column5: 客户需要批准标志的摆放位置。

column2: We should reject the frame because the character's face has changed.
column3: 这张画面中的角色脸变了，我们应该驳回它。
column4: Did the reviewer reject the whole sequence or just this shot?
column5: 审核者驳回了整段序列，还是只有这个镜头？

column2: The rejection note says the audio is too quiet.
column3: 驳回说明指出，音频声音太小。
column4: We need a clear reason for the rejection so the editor can fix it.
column5: 我们需要明确的驳回理由，让剪辑师知道怎样修改。

column2: Leave a comment at the exact frame where the hand changes.
column3: 在手部发生变化的那一帧留下批注。
column4: This comment refers to the opening title, not the closing credits.
column5: 这条评论针对开场标题，不是片尾字幕。

column2: The critique focuses on whether the story is easy to follow.
column3: 这次作品评议关注故事是否容易理解。
column4: I'd like a critique of the draft before adding more effects.
column5: 增加更多特效之前，我想听听对草稿的评议。

column2: The criticism of the pacing is fair.
column3: 对节奏的批评有道理。
column4: Let's separate useful criticism from personal preferences.
column5: 我们把有用的批评意见和个人偏好分开吧。

column2: We need to revise the scene where the motivation is unclear.
column3: 我们需要修订角色动机不清楚的那个场景。
column4: Could you revise the last paragraph without changing its meaning?
column5: 你能修改最后一段，同时保持原意吗？

column2: The grammar is correct, but the line sounds unnatural.
column3: 语法没错，但这句台词听起来不自然。
column4: Check the grammar after translating the captions.
column5: 翻译字幕后，检查一下语法。

column2: The punctuation makes this sentence hard to read aloud.
column3: 这句话的标点让它很难顺畅朗读。
column4: Use consistent punctuation throughout the subtitle file.
column5: 整个字幕文件要使用一致的标点。

column2: We shortened the introduction to improve clarity.
column3: 我们缩短了引言，让表达更清楚。
column4: The visual effect adds drama but reduces clarity.
column5: 这个视觉效果增加了戏剧感，却降低了表达清晰度。

column2: The second revision improved the coherence of the story.
column3: 第二次修订改善了故事的连贯性。
column4: We need to check coherence between the narration and the images.
column5: 我们需要检查旁白和画面之间是否连贯。

column2: Keep the instruction concise enough to fit on one screen.
column3: 把说明写得简洁一些，让它能放在一屏内。
column4: The concise version leaves more time for the demonstration.
column5: 简洁的版本给演示留出了更多时间。

column2: The dialogue is fluent, but it doesn't sound like this character.
column3: 对话很流畅，却不像这个角色会说的话。
column4: How can we make the dialogue sound fluent without speeding it up?
column5: 我们怎样让对话听起来流畅，又不加快语速？

column2: Read the paragraph aloud to check its fluency.
column3: 把这段话读出来，检查流畅度。
column4: The edits improved fluency without adding extra information.
column5: 修改让表达更流畅，没有增加额外信息。

column2: I'd like a natural speaking pace for the tutorial.
column3: 我希望教程使用自然的讲话速度。
column4: The hand movement doesn't look natural yet.
column5: 手部动作看起来还不自然。

column2: Use authentic details from the interview in the script.
column3: 在脚本中使用采访里真实的细节。
column4: The dialogue feels more authentic when the characters don't explain everything.
column5: 角色不把一切都解释清楚时，对话反而显得更真实。

column2: The formal version suits the company announcement.
column3: 正式版本适合这则公司公告。
column4: The dialogue is too formal for two close friends.
column5: 这段对话对两个好朋友来说太正式了。

column2: Use an informal tone for the behind-the-scenes post.
column3: 幕后帖子可以用非正式的语气。
column4: The informal introduction helps the interview feel relaxed.
column5: 不那么正式的开场让采访显得轻松。

column2: The character needs a casual outfit for this scene.
column3: 这个场景里的角色需要穿日常便装。
column4: Could the voiceover sound more casual?
column5: 旁白能更像日常说话吗？

column2: The welcome message should sound friendly without being pushy.
column3: 欢迎信息要亲切，不要咄咄逼人。
column4: A friendly expression would fit this scene better than a big grin.
column5: 亲切的表情比咧嘴大笑更适合这个场景。

column2: The layout looks professional, but the text is too small.
column3: 版式看起来专业，但字太小了。
column4: Keep the response professional even when the feedback is frustrating.
column5: 即使反馈让人烦躁，回复也要保持专业。

column2: The humorous version works better with a shorter pause.
column3: 幽默版本的停顿短一些，效果更好。
column4: We need a humorous ending that still fits the character.
column5: 我们需要一个幽默、同时符合角色的结尾。

column2: The humour comes from the contrast between the two characters.
column3: 幽默来自两个角色之间的反差。
column4: This scene doesn't need more humour; it needs a clearer setup.
column5: 这个场景不需要增加幽默，而是需要更清楚的铺垫。

column2: The humor was lost in the translation.
column3: 翻译后，幽默感没了。
column4: Can we keep the humor without making the customer look foolish?
column5: 我们能保留幽默，又不让客户显得愚蠢吗？

column2: The sarcasm is easy to miss in the generated voice.
column3: 生成的声音里，这种讽刺语气不容易听出来。
column4: Would this character really use sarcasm in that situation?
column5: 这个角色在那种情况下真的会用讽刺语气吗？

column2: The irony is that the expert makes the simplest mistake.
column3: 反讽在于，专家犯了最简单的错误。
column4: We need to make the irony clear without explaining the joke.
column5: 我们需要让反讽清楚一些，又不能把笑点解释出来。

column2: The script uses a bridge as a metaphor for trust.
column3: 脚本用桥来比喻信任。
column4: That metaphor is hard to show in a short video.
column5: 这个隐喻很难在短视频里表现出来。

column2: Could we use a familiar analogy to explain the model?
column3: 我们能用一个熟悉的类比来解释这个模型吗？
column4: The analogy helps beginners, but we should explain where it stops working.
column5: 这个类比能帮助初学者，但我们也应该说明它在哪些地方不适用。

column2: This idiom doesn't translate well into Chinese.
column3: 这个习语很难直接译成中文。
column4: Choose an idiom the target audience will understand.
column5: 选一个目标受众能理解的习语。

column2: The phrase sounds like something from a corporate brochure.
column3: 这个词组听起来像公司宣传册里的话。
column4: Can we replace this phrase with everyday language?
column5: 我们能把这个词组换成日常说法吗？

column2: The same word appears three times in one sentence.
column3: 同一个词在一句话里出现了三次。
column4: Which word should we emphasise in the narration?
column5: 旁白里应该强调哪个词？

column2: This sentence is too long for one subtitle.
column3: 这句话太长，一条字幕放不下。
column4: Let's split the sentence where the speaker naturally pauses.
column5: 我们在说话者自然停顿的地方把这句话拆开吧。

column2: Move this paragraph before the example.
column3: 把这一段移到例子前面。
column4: The paragraph repeats what the diagram already shows.
column5: 这段文字重复了图中已经呈现的信息。

column2: The chapter ends before the main question is answered.
column3: 这一章在回答主要问题之前就结束了。
column4: We need a clear opening for each chapter.
column5: 每一章都需要一个清楚的开头。

column2: This section explains how to use the reference image.
column3: 这一部分解释了怎样使用参考图。
column4: Could we remove the section that repeats the introduction?
column5: 我们能删掉重复引言的那一部分吗？

column2: The headline promises more than the article delivers.
column3: 标题承诺的内容超过了文章实际提供的内容。
column4: Could you write a headline that explains the actual benefit?
column5: 你能写一个说明实际好处的标题吗？

column2: The title disappears too quickly in the opening.
column3: 开场的标题消失得太快了。
column4: Does the title still make sense after the story changes?
column5: 故事修改后，这个作品标题还合适吗？

column2: The introduction takes too long to reach the main topic.
column3: 引言花了太多时间才进入主题。
column4: Let's record a new introduction for the updated tutorial.
column5: 我们为更新后的教程录一个新引言吧。

column2: The conclusion should answer the question raised at the beginning.
column3: 结尾应该回答开头提出的问题。
column4: This conclusion adds a new idea that needs more explanation.
column5: 这个结尾引入了一个需要更多解释的新想法。

column2: The summary leaves out the main limitation of the experiment.
column3: 摘要漏掉了这个实验的主要限制。
column4: Could you add a short summary before the detailed instructions?
column5: 你能在详细说明前加一段简短摘要吗？

column2: Can you summarize the changes for the review meeting?
column3: 你能为审核会议概括一下修改内容吗？
column4: We need to summarize the story without revealing the ending.
column5: 我们需要概括故事，但不能透露结局。

column2: The synopsis describes the conflict but not the resolution.
column3: 故事梗概写了冲突，却没有写如何解决。
column4: Send a one-page synopsis before the full screenplay.
column5: 先发一页故事梗概，再发完整剧本。

column2: The premise is that nobody can remember yesterday.
column3: 故事前提是，没有人记得昨天。
column4: We need to test whether this premise can sustain a whole episode.
column5: 我们需要看看这个故事前提能否支撑一整集。

column2: The concept is interesting, but the audience needs a clearer example.
column3: 这个概念很有意思，但受众需要一个更清楚的例子。
column4: Let's sketch the concept before writing a detailed prompt.
column5: 写详细提示词之前，先把概念画成草图。

column2: I like the idea of showing the same event from two viewpoints.
column3: 我喜欢从两个视角呈现同一事件的想法。
column4: The idea is simple enough for a thirty-second video.
column5: 这个想法足够简单，可以放进三十秒视频。

column2: The interview gave us inspiration for the opening scene.
column3: 这次采访给了我们开场场景的灵感。
column4: We can use the photo for inspiration without copying its composition.
column5: 我们可以从照片中获取灵感，不必照搬构图。

column2: Let's brainstorm three different ways to explain this.
column3: 我们来构思三种不同的解释方式吧。
column4: Could we brainstorm the ending before generating more shots?
column5: 生成更多镜头之前，我们能先构思一下结尾吗？

column2: The brainstorming session produced two ideas worth testing.
column3: 这次头脑风暴产生了两个值得测试的想法。
column4: We need a clear question for the brainstorming session.
column5: 头脑风暴需要一个明确的问题。

column2: The doorway looks wrong because the perspective is inconsistent.
column3: 门框看起来不对，因为透视不一致。
column4: Let's tell this scene from the child's perspective.
column5: 我们从孩子的视角来讲这个场景吧。

column2: The narrator's viewpoint changes halfway through the chapter.
column3: 这一章中途改变了旁白的叙述视角。
column4: We need to choose a viewpoint before rewriting the scene.
column5: 重写场景前，我们需要确定叙述视角。

column2: The protagonist needs a reason to leave home.
column3: 主角需要一个离家的理由。
column4: What does the protagonist want at the beginning of the story?
column5: 故事开始时，主角想要什么？

column2: The antagonist should have a goal beyond stopping the hero.
column3: 对立角色不应该只是阻止主角，也应该有自己的目标。
column4: We haven't shown why the antagonist made this decision.
column5: 我们还没有展示对立角色为什么作出这个决定。

column2: The character's motivation isn't clear in this version.
column3: 这个版本里，角色的动机不清楚。
column4: Can we show the motivation through an action rather than a speech?
column5: 我们能通过行动，而不是一段讲话来展示动机吗？

column2: The conflict starts when both characters want the same room.
column3: 两个角色都想要同一间房时，冲突开始了。
column4: This scene needs a conflict that matters to the audience.
column5: 这个场景需要一个受众在意的冲突。

column2: The climax arrives before we've established the stakes.
column3: 我们还没交代清楚利害关系，高潮就来了。
column4: Let's slow down the moment just before the climax.
column5: 我们把高潮前的那一刻放慢一点吧。

column2: The pause builds suspense before the door opens.
column3: 开门前的停顿增加了悬念。
column4: Showing the answer too early removes the suspense.
column5: 太早展示答案会消除悬念。

column2: The pace feels too fast for this emotional scene.
column3: 对这个情感场景来说，节奏太快了。
column4: We can change the pace by holding the reaction shot longer.
column5: 我们可以让反应镜头多停留一会儿，调整节奏。

column2: The character's arc should be visible across the three episodes.
column3: 角色的发展弧线应该贯穿这三集。
column4: Does this decision fit the story arc we've established?
column5: 这个决定符合我们已经建立的故事发展弧线吗？

column2: The structure moves from the problem to a practical demonstration.
column3: 这个结构从问题进入实际演示。
column4: We should fix the structure before polishing individual sentences.
column5: 润色具体句子之前，我们应该先调整结构。

column2: There's a continuity error in the position of the bag.
column3: 包的位置出现了连续性错误。
column4: Check continuity between the wide shot and the close-up.
column5: 检查全景和特写之间的连续性。

column2: The flashback explains why she recognises the house.
column3: 闪回解释了她为什么认得这栋房子。
column4: Can we make the flashback visually distinct from the present?
column5: 我们能让闪回在视觉上与现在区分开吗？

column2: The story world needs consistent rules.
column3: 故事世界需要一致的规则。
column4: What does the audience need to know about this world before the action starts?
column5: 行动开始前，受众需要了解这个世界的哪些信息？

column2: This work of fiction is set in an invented city.
column3: 这部虚构作品发生在一座虚构的城市里。
column4: We should make it clear that the dialogue is fiction.
column5: 我们应该明确说明，这段对话是虚构的。

column2: The nonfiction script needs sources for its factual claims.
column3: 非虚构脚本中的事实性说法需要来源支持。
column4: We can't invent a quotation for a nonfiction piece.
column5: 我们不能给非虚构作品编造引语。

column2: The fantasy setting still needs a believable emotional conflict.
column3: 奇幻背景仍然需要一个可信的情感冲突。
column4: I'd like the fantasy creature to feel heavy enough to affect the ground.
column5: 我希望这个奇幻生物有足够的重量感，能对地面产生影响。

column2: The science explanation needs checking before we animate it.
column3: 制作动画前，需要核查科学解释。
column4: This scene belongs in a science fiction story, not a documentary.
column5: 这个场景应该出现在科幻故事中，不是纪录片中。

column2: The horror scene is stronger when we don't show everything.
column3: 不把一切都展示出来时，恐怖场景更有力量。
column4: We need sound that suits horror without drowning out the dialogue.
column5: 我们需要适合恐怖类型、又不会盖住对话的声音。

column2: The thriller needs a clue that the audience can notice later.
column3: 这个惊悚作品需要一个受众之后能注意到的线索。
column4: The opening feels more like a thriller than a comedy.
column5: 这个开场更像惊悚作品，而不是喜剧。

column2: The comedy depends on the timing of the reaction.
column3: 这个喜剧效果取决于反应的时机。
column4: We shouldn't add comedy to the scene where the character is grieving.
column5: 角色悲伤的场景里，不应该加入喜剧元素。

column2: The drama comes from the choice between family and work.
column3: 戏剧冲突来自家庭和工作之间的选择。
column4: This quiet conversation carries more drama than the chase.
column5: 这段安静的对话比追逐场面更有戏剧张力。

column2: The romance develops through small shared moments.
column3: 这段爱情通过一些共同经历的小瞬间发展。
column4: The romance subplot needs more than one sudden confession.
column5: 爱情支线不能只靠一次突然告白。

column2: The adventure should change how the characters see each other.
column3: 这段冒险应该改变角色对彼此的看法。
column4: We need a quieter moment after the adventure ends.
column5: 冒险结束后，我们需要一个更平静的时刻。

column2: The action is hard to follow because the camera keeps changing direction.
column3: 镜头一直改变方向，让动作场面难以看懂。
column4: Let's show the character's reaction before the next action sequence.
column5: 下一个动作段落之前，我们先展示角色的反应。

column2: Which genre best fits this story?
column3: 哪种类型最适合这个故事？
column4: The genre affects what the audience expects from the opening.
column5: 作品类型会影响受众对开场的期待。

column2: We can adapt the chapter into three short scenes.
column3: 我们可以把这一章改编成三个短场景。
column4: How should we adapt the joke for a different audience?
column5: 面对不同的受众，我们应该怎样改编这个笑话？

column2: The screenplay needs a clearer transition between locations.
column3: 这个电影剧本需要更清楚的地点转换。
column4: The editor asked for the latest version of the screenplay.
column5: 剪辑师要求提供最新版本的电影剧本。

column2: The second take has the clearest pronunciation.
column3: 第二条拍摄的发音最清楚。
column4: Can we do another take with a longer pause?
column5: 我们能再拍一条，把停顿拉长一些吗？

column2: The montage shows several weeks passing in a few seconds.
column3: 这个蒙太奇用几秒钟表现了几周过去。
column4: The montage needs a final shot that brings us back to the present.
column5: 这个蒙太奇需要一个把我们带回现在的结尾镜头。

column2: The teaser should suggest the conflict without revealing the solution.
column3: 预告短片应该透露冲突，但不揭晓解决方式。
column4: Could we cut a shorter teaser for the launch post?
column5: 我们能为上线帖子剪一个更短的预告短片吗？

column2: The trailer gives away too much of the ending.
column3: 这段预告片透露了太多结局内容。
column4: The trailer needs to show what makes the story different.
column5: 预告片需要展示这个故事的特别之处。

column2: The promo needs a clear explanation of the event.
column3: 宣传片需要清楚说明活动内容。
column4: We should use the confirmed date in the promo.
column5: 我们应该在宣传片中使用已经确认的日期。

column2: The documentary includes interviews with the people involved.
column3: 这部纪录片包含对当事人的采访。
column4: The documentary editor asked us to verify the date on the archive footage.
column5: 纪录片剪辑师让我们核实档案影像上的日期。

column2: The tutorial skips a step that beginners need.
column3: 这个教程跳过了初学者需要的一个步骤。
column4: Let's record the tutorial using the current interface.
column5: 我们用当前界面录制教程吧。

column2: The interview works better when the guest has time to answer.
column3: 给嘉宾时间回答，采访效果会更好。
column4: The interview transcript includes a correction from the guest.
column5: 采访转写稿中包含了嘉宾的更正。

column2: The podcast needs a short introduction to the guest.
column3: 这期播客需要一段简短的嘉宾介绍。
column4: Can we make an audio-only version for the podcast?
column5: 我们能为播客制作一个纯音频版本吗？

column2: The broadcast needs captions for viewers watching without sound.
column3: 播出内容需要字幕，方便静音观看的人。
column4: What time will we broadcast the interview?
column5: 我们几点播出这段采访？

column2: This episode introduces the main character's problem.
column3: 这一集介绍了主角面临的问题。
column4: The episode is too long for the planned release slot.
column5: 这一集太长，放不进计划的播出时段。

column2: The series needs a consistent opening style.
column3: 这个系列需要一致的开场风格。
column4: Can each video in the series work on its own?
column5: 系列里的每个视频能独立观看吗？

column2: The short tells one complete story in three minutes.
column3: 这部短片用三分钟讲了一个完整故事。
column4: We need a different ending for the short.
column5: 我们需要为这部短片换一个结尾。

column2: The sound needs testing before the cinema screening.
column3: 在影院放映前，需要测试声音。
column4: The class explores how cinema tells stories through images.
column5: 这堂课探讨电影怎样通过画面讲故事。

column2: The lighting looks cinematic, but the faces are difficult to see.
column3: 灯光有电影感，但人物的脸不好看清。
column4: We can make the scene cinematic without adding dramatic music everywhere.
column5: 我们不用到处加戏剧性音乐，也能让场景有电影感。

column2: The film begins with an empty room.
column3: 这部影片以一个空房间开场。
column4: We need to check the subtitles throughout the film.
column5: 我们需要检查整部影片的字幕。

column2: The movie poster uses a different costume from the final scene.
column3: 电影海报使用的服装与最终场景不同。
column4: What does the audience know at this point in the movie?
column5: 在电影进行到这里时，观众知道了什么？

column2: We plan to shoot the interview in a quiet room.
column3: 我们计划在一个安静的房间里拍采访。
column4: Can we shoot a reference clip for this movement?
column5: 我们能为这个动作拍一段参考短片吗？

column2: The studio booking includes time for the sound check.
column3: 摄影棚预订包含了声音检查的时间。
column4: Our studio keeps a separate folder for each client's source files.
column5: 我们的工作室为每个客户的源文件保留独立文件夹。

column2: The set needs a doorway that matches the earlier scene.
column3: 这个布景需要一个与之前场景一致的门口。
column4: We should photograph the set before moving the props.
column5: 移动道具前，我们应该把布景拍下来。

column2: The location is too noisy for clean dialogue.
column3: 这个拍摄地点太吵，无法录出干净的对话。
column4: We need permission before filming at this location.
column5: 我们需要先获得许可，才能在这个地点拍摄。

column2: The prop changes colour between shots.
column3: 这个道具在不同镜头间变了颜色。
column4: Can we replace this prop with something the character would actually carry?
column5: 我们能把这个道具换成角色确实会随身携带的东西吗？

column2: The costume should show that the character has been travelling.
column3: 服装应该让人看出角色一直在旅行。
column4: We need a reference image for the costume in each scene.
column5: 我们需要每个场景中服装的参考图。

column2: The wardrobe team needs the updated scene list.
column3: 戏服团队需要更新后的场景清单。
column4: Keep the wardrobe consistent across the character's reference images.
column5: 角色参考图中的服装要保持一致。

column2: The makeup looks too polished for this tired character.
column3: 对这个疲惫的角色来说，妆容太精致了。
column4: Can we keep the makeup the same in the close-up?
column5: 特写里的妆容能保持一致吗？

column2: The light should come from the window on the left.
column3: 光线应该来自左侧的窗户。
column4: There's too much light on the background compared with the face.
column5: 相比脸部，背景上的光太多了。

column2: The illumination changes abruptly when the camera turns.
column3: 镜头转动时，照明突然变了。
column4: We need softer illumination for the interview setup.
column5: 采访布置需要更柔和的照明。

column2: A small lamp will illuminate the desk.
column3: 一盏小灯会照亮桌面。
column4: Can we illuminate the doorway without brightening the whole room?
column5: 我们能只照亮门口，而不把整个房间都弄亮吗？

column2: The exposure differs between the two camera angles.
column3: 两个拍摄角度的曝光不同。
column4: Check the exposure before adjusting the colour grade.
column5: 调色前，先检查曝光。

column2: Which aperture was used for the reference shot?
column3: 参考镜头用了什么光圈？
column4: We need to record the aperture setting for the next take.
column5: 我们需要为下一条拍摄记录光圈设置。

column2: The shutter speed affects how the movement looks.
column3: 快门速度会影响运动的呈现方式。
column4: Check whether the shutter setting changed between takes.
column5: 检查不同拍摄条次之间，快门设置是否变了。

column2: The focus shifts away from the character's eyes.
column3: 焦点偏离了角色的眼睛。
column4: We need to focus on the hand as it picks up the key.
column5: 手拿起钥匙时，我们需要对焦到手上。

column2: Use the same focal length for these reference portraits.
column3: 这些参考肖像使用相同焦距。
column4: The focal point of the composition should be the face.
column5: 构图的视觉焦点应该是脸部。

column2: The zoom is distracting during the explanation.
column3: 讲解时的变焦让人分心。
column4: Could we zoom in more slowly on the diagram?
column5: 我们能更慢地放大这张示意图吗？

column2: Let's pan across the room before showing the character.
column3: 展示角色前，我们先水平摇镜扫过房间。
column4: The pan stops before the audience can see the window.
column5: 观众还没看到窗户，水平摇镜就停了。

column2: The camera should tilt down to reveal the note.
column3: 镜头应该向下摇，展示那张便条。
column4: This tilt is too fast for the viewer to follow.
column5: 这个垂直摇镜太快，观众跟不上。

column2: The dolly move follows the character towards the doorway.
column3: 摄影移动台的运动跟着角色走向门口。
column4: Can we test the dolly movement with a simple preview?
column5: 我们能用一个简单预览测试移动台镜头运动吗？

column2: The aerial shot establishes the size of the city.
column3: 航拍镜头交代了城市规模。
column4: Do we need an aerial view, or would a street-level shot work better?
column5: 我们需要航拍视角，还是街面镜头会更好？

column2: The drone footage needs stabilisation before the edit.
column3: 无人机素材需要先稳定，再剪辑。
column4: Ask the producer whether the drone shot can be used in this project.
column5: 问问制片人，这段无人机镜头能否用于这个项目。

column2: The tripod keeps the camera in the same position for both takes.
column3: 三脚架让两条拍摄中的相机位置保持相同。
column4: We forgot to remove the tripod from the background.
column5: 我们忘了把背景里的三脚架移走。

column2: The stabilizer reduced the shake but changed the framing.
column3: 稳定器减少了抖动，但改变了取景。
column4: Which stabilizer was used for the walking shot?
column5: 步行镜头用了哪种稳定器？

column2: The angle hides the object the character is pointing at.
column3: 这个角度遮住了角色正在指的物体。
column4: Let's try an angle that shows both faces.
column5: 我们试试能同时展示两张脸的角度吧。

column2: The preview has a separate view for checking the camera position.
column3: 预览里有一个独立视图，用来检查相机位置。
column4: The platform counted a view before the clip had finished.
column5: 视频还没播放完，平台就计入了一次观看。

column2: Would a wide-angle lens help us show the cramped room?
column3: 用广角镜头能帮助我们展示这间狭小的房间吗？
column4: The wide lens makes the person near the edge look stretched.
column5: 广角镜头让靠近边缘的人看起来被拉长了。

column2: The medium shot lets us see the hands and the facial reaction.
column3: 中景让我们能同时看到手部和面部反应。
column4: Which medium is best for this idea: a video or an illustrated guide?
column5: 这个想法最适合哪种媒介：视频还是图文指南？

column2: The telephoto lens gives us a tighter view of the performer.
column3: 长焦镜头让我们更紧凑地拍到表演者。
column4: Do we have a telephoto reference for the distant building?
column5: 我们有没有远处建筑的长焦参考图？

column2: The macro shot shows the texture of the fabric.
column3: 微距镜头展示了布料的纹理。
column4: Can we use a macro view for this tiny detail?
column5: 我们能用微距视图展示这个小细节吗？

column2: The depth of field changes between these two shots.
column3: 这两个镜头之间的景深变了。
column4: The flat background makes the scene lose its sense of depth.
column5: 平面的背景让场景失去了空间深度感。

column2: The field of view is too narrow to show the whole room.
column3: 视野太窄，无法展示整个房间。
column4: Can we match the field of view to the reference camera?
column5: 我们能把视野调得与参考相机一致吗？

column2: The symmetry makes the poster feel calm and formal.
column3: 对称让海报显得平静而正式。
column4: Check the symmetry of the generated face before approving it.
column5: 批准生成的人脸之前，检查一下对称情况。

column2: A little asymmetry makes the pose feel less stiff.
column3: 一点不对称会让姿势不那么僵硬。
column4: The asymmetry in the layout draws attention to the title.
column5: 版式中的不对称把注意力引向了标题。

column2: The composition needs more balance between the text and the image.
column3: 构图中的文字和图像需要更均衡。
column4: Does the dark shape on the left disturb the balance?
column5: 左侧的深色形状会破坏画面均衡吗？

column2: The head is out of proportion to the body.
column3: 头部和身体的比例不对。
column4: We need to preserve the proportion of the logo when resizing it.
column5: 改变标志大小时，我们需要保持比例。

column2: The scale of the doorway makes the character look too small.
column3: 门口的尺度让角色显得太小了。
column4: Use a familiar object to show the scale of the creature.
column5: 用一个熟悉的物体来表现生物的尺度。

column2: The silhouette is clear even at a small size.
column3: 这个剪影即使缩小也很清楚。
column4: Can we recognise the character from the silhouette alone?
column5: 我们能只通过剪影认出这个角色吗？

column2: The shape of the bag changes in the next frame.
column3: 下一帧里，包的形状变了。
column4: We need a simpler shape for this small icon.
column5: 这个小图标需要更简单的形状。

column2: The form of the creature should suggest how it moves.
column3: 生物的形态应该让人能看出它怎样运动。
column4: The lighting helps reveal the form of the object.
column5: 灯光帮助呈现物体的形态。

column2: The contour of the hand is broken near the wrist.
column3: 手部轮廓线在手腕附近断开了。
column4: Could you simplify the contour without losing the pose?
column5: 你能简化轮廓线，同时保留姿势吗？

column2: There's a bright edge around the cutout.
column3: 抠出的图像周围有一圈亮边。
column4: The edge of the label is too close to the crop.
column5: 标签边缘离裁切位置太近了。

column2: The line should follow the curve of the character's shoulder.
column3: 这条线应该沿着角色肩部的曲线走。
column4: Make the dividing line lighter so it doesn't dominate the page.
column5: 把分隔线变浅一些，让它别在页面中太抢眼。

column2: The curve looks uneven near the corner.
column3: 拐角附近的曲线看起来不平顺。
column4: Can we use a smoother curve for the motion path?
column5: 我们能给运动路径使用更平滑的曲线吗？

column2: The surface looks like plastic instead of wood.
column3: 表面看起来像塑料，不像木头。
column4: We need a reference showing how light falls on this surface.
column5: 我们需要一张展示光线落在这个表面上的参考图。

column2: The material is too reflective for worn leather.
column3: 对于磨旧的皮革来说，这个材质太反光了。
column4: Which material should we use for the window frame?
column5: 窗框应该用什么材质？

column2: The mesh has a hole near the elbow.
column3: 网格在肘部附近有一个洞。
column4: Can we simplify the mesh before testing the animation?
column5: 测试动画前，我们能先简化网格吗？

column2: The geometry bends incorrectly when the arm moves.
column3: 手臂移动时，几何结构的弯曲不正确。
column4: We need to check the geometry hidden behind the costume.
column5: 我们需要检查服装后面被遮住的几何结构。

column2: The geometric pattern should repeat without a visible break.
column3: 这个几何图案应该连续重复，看不出断点。
column4: A geometric shape may work better than a detailed illustration here.
column5: 这里用几何形状可能比复杂插画更合适。

column2: The rig needs a control for the character's eyebrows.
column3: 动画骨架系统需要一个控制角色眉毛的功能。
column4: Test the rig before adding the final animation.
column5: 添加最终动画之前，测试一下骨架系统。

column2: The skeleton doesn't match the proportions of the model.
column3: 骨架与模型的比例不一致。
column4: We need to check the skeleton inside the imported character.
column5: 我们需要检查导入角色内部的骨架。

column2: The bone is rotating around the wrong point.
column3: 这根骨骼正在绕错误的位置旋转。
column4: Which bone controls the wrist movement?
column5: 哪根骨骼控制手腕运动？

column2: The elbow joint bends in the wrong direction.
column3: 肘关节向错误的方向弯曲了。
column4: The animator asked for a closer view of the shoulder joint.
column5: 动画师要求看肩关节的更近视图。

column2: The pose looks balanced, but the feet don't touch the ground.
column3: 姿势看起来平衡，但脚没有接触地面。
column4: Can we keep this pose for the character reference sheet?
column5: 角色参考表能保留这个姿势吗？

column2: The cloth simulation clips through the chair.
column3: 布料模拟穿过了椅子。
column4: We need a short simulation test before the final render.
column5: 最终渲染前，我们需要做一个短模拟测试。

column2: Can we simulate the curtain moving in a light breeze?
column3: 我们能模拟窗帘在微风中移动吗？
column4: The preview doesn't need to simulate every small particle.
column5: 预览不需要模拟每一个小粒子。

column2: The physics setup makes the ball bounce too much.
column3: 这个物理模拟设置让球弹得太多了。
column4: Let's test the physics before adding detailed materials.
column5: 添加复杂材质之前，我们先测试物理模拟吧。

column2: Each particle follows the same path in this test.
column3: 这个测试中的每个粒子都沿着同一路径运动。
column4: The particle effect is hiding the character's face.
column5: 粒子效果遮住了角色的脸。

column2: The collision test shows the hand passing through the table.
column3: 碰撞测试显示，手穿过了桌子。
column4: We need a simpler collision shape for the background objects.
column5: 背景物体需要一个更简单的碰撞形状。

column2: The cloth moves as though it has no weight.
column3: 布料移动起来像没有重量。
column4: Can we use a different cloth reference for the coat?
column5: 我们能给外套换一份布料参考吗？

column2: The hair changes length halfway through the shot.
column3: 镜头进行到一半时，头发长度变了。
column4: Keep the hair out of the eyes in this close-up.
column5: 这个特写里，头发不要挡住眼睛。

column3: 杯子还没倾斜，液体就洒出来了。

column3: 流体模拟需要在容器周围留出更多空间。
column4: The artist adjusted the fluid settings after checking the reference.
column5: 美术人员核对参考后，调整了流体设置。

column2: The smoke moves against the direction of the wind in the scene.
column3: 烟雾移动的方向与场景里的风向相反。

column5: 烟雾效果太浓，门口都看不清了。

column3: 火焰效果需要照亮附近的墙面。

column3: 环境音与这个空房间不相符。
column4: Reduce the ambient light so the desk lamp has more effect.
column5: 降低环境光，让台灯更能发挥作用。

column2: The reflection shows an object that isn't in the scene.
column3: 反射里出现了场景中没有的物体。

column5: 改变相机位置后，检查窗户里的反射。

column2: The reflective surface is picking up the wrong background.
column3: 反光表面映出了错误的背景。
column4: Can the sign be less reflective so the text stays readable?
column5: 招牌能少反光一点，让文字保持可读吗？

column2: The shader combines diffuse reflection with a glossy layer.
column3: 这个着色器把漫反射和光泽层组合起来。
column4: We need to check the diffuse colour before adding more effects.
column5: 添加更多效果前，我们需要检查漫反射颜色。

column2: Increasing the roughness changed the appearance of the highlight.
column3: 增加粗糙度后，高光的样子变了。
column4: The roughness map has a visible seam near the edge.
column5: 粗糙度贴图在边缘附近有一条明显接缝。

column2: The metallic setting makes the wooden box look wrong.
column3: 金属质感设置让木盒看起来不对。
column4: We need a metallic material for the buckle, not the whole belt.
column5: 我们需要给搭扣用金属材质，不是整条皮带。

column2: The opacity is too low for the text to stand out.
column3: 不透明度太低，文字不够突出。
column4: Can we animate the opacity as the label appears?
column5: 标签出现时，我们能给不透明度做动画吗？

column2: The translucent curtain lets some light into the room.
column3: 半透明窗帘让一些光线进入房间。
column4: This surface should be translucent rather than completely transparent.
column5: 这个表面应该是半透明的，不是完全透明的。

column2: The emission makes the sign appear to glow.
column3: 自发光让招牌看起来在发亮。
column4: Check whether the emission is affecting the surrounding objects in this render.
column5: 检查这次渲染里，自发光是否影响了周围物体。

column2: The luminosity of the background competes with the title.
column3: 背景的明亮度抢了标题的注意力。
column4: Could we reduce the luminosity of this effect?
column5: 我们能降低这个效果的明亮度吗？

column2: The hue of the jacket has shifted towards green.
column3: 夹克的色相偏绿了。
column4: Keep the hue consistent across the product images.
column5: 产品图之间的色相要保持一致。

column2: The palette uses three main colours.
column3: 这个配色方案使用了三种主色。
column4: We need a palette that still works on a small screen.
column5: 我们需要一个在小屏幕上也有效的配色方案。

column2: The warm lighting makes the scene feel welcoming.
column3: 暖色灯光让场景显得亲切。
column4: This version is too warm compared with the reference.
column5: 与参考相比，这个版本的色调太暖了。

column2: Use a cool background to separate it from the warm foreground.
column3: 用冷色背景来区分暖色前景。
column4: The cool tones fit the night scene better.
column5: 冷色调更适合这个夜景。

column2: A neutral background would make the product easier to judge.
column3: 中性背景会让产品更容易被判断。
column4: We need a neutral grey for the comparison chart.
column5: 对比图表需要一种中性灰色。

column2: The vibrant colours suit the festival poster.
column3: 鲜艳的颜色适合节日海报。
column4: Can we make the title vibrant without changing the whole palette?
column5: 我们能让标题鲜艳一些，而不改变整个配色吗？

column2: The muted palette keeps attention on the character.
column3: 柔和低饱和的配色把注意力留在角色身上。
column4: This scene needs a muted background rather than a bright one.
column5: 这个场景需要柔和的背景，不要太鲜亮。

column2: The vivid red draws attention to the warning label.
column3: 鲜明的红色把注意力引向警告标签。
column4: The memory scene can use more vivid colours than the present.
column5: 回忆场景可以比现在的场景用更鲜明的颜色。

column2: The monochrome version makes the shapes easier to compare.
column3: 单色版本让形状更容易比较。
column4: Could we test the poster in monochrome first?
column5: 我们能先测试海报的单色版本吗？

column2: The sepia tone makes the flashback feel older.
column3: 棕褐色调让闪回显得更有年代感。
column4: We need a sepia version for the character's memory sequence.
column5: 角色的回忆段落需要一个棕褐色版本。

column2: The pastel colours are too pale against this background.
column3: 这些粉彩色在这个背景上太浅了。
column4: I'd like a pastel palette for the invitation design.
column5: 我希望邀请函设计使用粉彩配色。

column2: The complementary colours make the two sections distinct.
column3: 互补色让这两个部分区别明显。
column4: Can we try a complementary palette for the poster?
column5: 我们能为海报试试互补色配色吗？

column2: The analogous colour scheme makes the scene feel unified.
column3: 类似色配色让场景显得统一。
column4: We chose analogous colours for the background illustrations.
column5: 我们给背景插画选择了类似色。

column2: The gradation is uneven near the brightest area.
column3: 最亮区域附近的色调渐变不均匀。
column4: We need a softer gradation between the two background colours.
column5: 两种背景颜色之间需要更柔和的渐变。

column2: The shadow points in a different direction from the light.
column3: 阴影的方向与灯光不对应。
column4: Can we keep the shadow from covering the subtitle?
column5: 我们能让阴影别遮住字幕吗？

column2: The highlight on the face is too bright.
column3: 脸上的高光太亮了。
column4: We lost detail in the highlight after the colour adjustment.
column5: 调色后，高光里的细节丢失了。

column2: The glow around the title makes the letters harder to read.
column3: 标题周围的光晕让字更难读了。
column4: We need a subtle glow from the screen onto the face.
column5: 我们需要屏幕在脸上投出一点柔和的光。

column2: The bloom effect is washing out the small lights.
column3: 辉光效果让小灯的细节变淡了。
column4: Can we compare the render with and without bloom?
column5: 我们能对比有辉光和没有辉光的渲染吗？

column2: The glare on the window hides the character inside.
column3: 窗户上的眩光遮住了里面的角色。
column4: We need to reduce the glare before placing text over this shot.
column5: 在这个镜头上放文字之前，我们需要减弱眩光。

column2: The lens flare crosses the actor's eyes.
column3: 镜头光晕经过了演员的眼睛。
column4: Does the flare fit the direction of the light source?
column5: 这个镜头光晕与光源方向相符吗？

column2: The background blur looks uneven around the hair.
column3: 头发周围的背景模糊看起来不均匀。
column4: Could you blur the personal details in this screenshot?
column5: 你能模糊处理这张截图中的个人信息吗？

column2: The face becomes blurry during the turn.
column3: 转身时，脸变得模糊了。
column4: This preview is too blurry to check the small text.
column5: 这个预览太模糊，无法检查小字。

column2: The product label needs to stay sharp throughout the shot.
column3: 产品标签需要在整个镜头里保持清晰。
column4: The background is sharp, but the subject isn't.
column5: 背景清晰，但主体不清晰。

column2: The extra sharpness makes the skin look unnatural.
column3: 增加的清晰度让皮肤看起来不自然。
column4: Check sharpness at the final viewing size.
column5: 按最终观看尺寸检查清晰度。

column2: Don't sharpen the image before checking the noise.
column3: 先检查噪点，再决定是否锐化图像。
column4: Could we sharpen just the product label?
column5: 我们能只锐化产品标签吗？

column2: There is visible noise in the dark part of the frame.
column3: 画面暗部有明显噪点。
column4: The noise in the recording is louder between sentences.
column5: 录音噪声在句子间隙更明显。

column2: The grain gives the image a textured look.
column3: 颗粒感让图像更有质感。
column4: Keep the grain consistent between the generated shots.
column5: 生成镜头之间的颗粒感要保持一致。

column2: There's an artifact near the character's mouth.
column3: 角色嘴边有一个生成伪影。
column4: We need to inspect this compression artifact in the exported file.
column5: 我们需要在导出文件中检查这个压缩伪影。

column2: The distortion makes the door frame bend.
column3: 畸变让门框弯曲了。
column4: Can we reduce the distortion without cropping out the hand?
column5: 我们能减少畸变，同时不裁掉手部吗？

column2: We should test a small crop before we upscale the full image.
column3: 放大整张图之前，我们应该先测试一块小裁切。
column4: Can this tool upscale the frame without changing the face?
column5: 这个工具能在不改变脸部的情况下放大画面吗？

column2: The composite needs a matching shadow under the character.
column3: 合成画面需要在角色下方加上匹配的阴影。
column4: We can composite the title over the footage after the colour grade.
column5: 调色后，我们可以把标题合成到素材上。

column2: The edge doesn't blend into the background.
column3: 这个边缘没能融入背景。
column4: Can we blend the two colours more gradually?
column5: 我们能让这两种颜色混合得更渐进吗？

column2: Please merge the duplicate subtitle tracks.
column3: 请合并重复的字幕轨道。
column4: We need to merge the review notes before sending them to the editor.
column5: 把审核意见发给剪辑师前，我们需要先合并它们。

column2: Keep an editable copy before you flatten the layers.
column3: 合并图层之前，保留一份可编辑副本。
column4: Do we need to flatten this artwork for the printer?
column5: 交给印刷方之前，我们需要合并这份作品的图层吗？

column2: Align the text with the left edge of the image.
column3: 让文字与图像左边缘对齐。
column4: The subtitles don't align with the speaker's timing.
column5: 字幕时间与说话者的时间不对齐。

column3: 你能把产品稍微转向相机吗？
column4: We need to rotate the logo without stretching it.
column5: 我们需要旋转标志，但不能拉伸它。

column2: The rotation is too fast at the end of the animation.
column3: 动画结尾的旋转太快了。
column4: Check the rotation of the wrist in the reference clip.
column5: 检查参考短片中手腕的旋转。

column2: Flip the image only if the text remains correct.
column3: 翻转图像之前，要确认文字不会出错。
column4: Can we flip the layout so the title is on the other side?
column5: 我们能翻转版式，让标题移到另一侧吗？

column2: The mirror effect also reverses the label.
column3: 镜像效果也反转了标签。
column4: Don't mirror the character if it changes which hand holds the key.
column5: 如果会改变拿钥匙的那只手，就不要把角色镜像翻转。

column2: We can transform this flat diagram into a simple animation.
column3: 我们可以把这个平面示意图变换成简单动画。
column4: Use the handles to transform the shape without changing its proportions.
column5: 用控制点变换形状，同时不改变比例。

column2: The transformation from the sketch to the final image is too abrupt.
column3: 从草图到最终图像的变换太突然了。
column4: Show the transformation in stages so the viewer can follow it.
column5: 分阶段展示变换，让观众能跟得上。

column2: The tool can warp the label around the bottle.
column3: 这个工具能把标签变形，使其贴合瓶身。
column4: We shouldn't warp the face to match the background.
column5: 我们不应该为了匹配背景而扭曲脸部。

column2: Could we expand the background to fit a vertical format?
column3: 我们能扩展背景，让它适合竖屏格式吗？
column4: The tool needs to expand the frame without moving the main subject.
column5: 这个工具需要扩展画面，同时不移动主体。

column2: Please erase the stray mark beside the title.
column3: 请擦除标题旁边多余的印记。
column4: Don't erase the shadow that connects the object to the floor.
column5: 不要擦掉把物体与地面联系起来的阴影。

column2: The eraser is removing part of the character's sleeve.
column3: 橡皮擦正在擦掉角色袖子的一部分。
column4: Use a smaller eraser near the edge of the face.
column5: 脸部边缘附近用小一点的橡皮擦。

column2: This brush leaves a rough texture along the line.
column3: 这支画笔沿线留下了粗糙的纹理。
column4: Can we use a softer brush for the shadow?
column5: 我们能用更柔和的画笔画阴影吗？

column2: The stroke is too thick for this small icon.
column3: 这个小图标的笔触太粗了。
column4: Try a single stroke instead of several overlapping marks.
column5: 试试一笔完成，不要叠加好几笔。

column2: The pen tool gives us more control over the curve.
column3: 钢笔工具让我们更容易控制曲线。
column4: Could you trace the shape with the pen tool?
column5: 你能用钢笔工具描出这个形状吗？

column2: The pencil sketch is enough to explain the composition.
column3: 这张铅笔草图已经足够说明构图。
column4: Keep the pencil texture visible in the final illustration.
column5: 最终插画里要保留铅笔纹理。

column2: The sketch shows the main movement but not the setting.
column3: 草图展示了主要动作，却没有展示环境。
column4: Let's sketch two alternatives before choosing a composition.
column5: 选择构图前，我们先画两个备选草图吧。

column2: The painting needs a stronger sense of depth.
column3: 这幅画需要更强的空间深度感。
column4: We should keep the original painting separate from the edited version.
column5: 我们应该把原画与修改后的版本分开保存。

column2: Can we paint a simpler background behind the character?
column3: 我们能在角色后面画一个更简单的背景吗？
column4: The artist will paint the missing section by hand.
column5: 美术人员会手动画出缺失部分。

column2: The canvas is wider than the required output size.
column3: 画布比要求的输出尺寸更宽。
column4: Add some space at the top of the canvas for the headline.
column5: 在画布顶部留一些空间放标题。

column3: 这份美术作品需要按印刷尺寸检查。
column4: Who created the original artwork used in this reference?
column5: 这份参考里的原始美术作品是谁创作的？

column2: Which settings will we use to encode the final video?
column3: 我们会用哪些设置编码最终视频？
column4: The server couldn't encode the uploaded clip.
column5: 服务器没能编码上传的短片。

column2: The player can't decode this version of the file.
column3: 播放器无法解码这个版本的文件。

column5: 我们需要解码一帧样本来检查输出。

column3: 左声道比右声道安静很多。
column4: Which channel will publish the tutorial first?
column5: 哪个内容频道会先发布教程？

column2: The stereo mix sounds unbalanced on headphones.
column3: 立体声混音在耳机上听起来不平衡。
column4: We need a stereo version for the review.
column5: 审核需要一个立体声版本。

column2: The voice was recorded in mono.
column3: 这段人声是用单声道录制的。
column4: Check the mix in mono as well as stereo.
column5: 除了立体声，也检查一下单声道混音。

column3: 环绕声混音需要在放映室检查。
column4: Do we have the correct speaker setup to review surround audio?
column5: 我们有合适的扬声器配置来审核环绕声音频吗？

column2: The frequency of the hum is visible in the analysis.
column3: 分析里可以看出嗡声的频率。
column4: Could you identify the frequency that is making the voice sound harsh?
column5: 你能找出让人声听起来刺耳的频率吗？

column2: The waveform shows a gap where the sentence should be.
column3: 波形显示，本应有句子的地方有一段空白。
column4: Zoom in on the waveform to check the edit point.
column5: 放大波形，检查剪辑点。

column2: The diagram shows how a sound wave travels through the room.
column3: 示意图展示了声波怎样穿过房间。
column4: Could we animate the wave to explain the audio effect?
column5: 我们能给这道声波做动画，解释音频效果吗？

column2: The amplitude rises sharply at the beginning of the shout.
column3: 喊声开始时，振幅急剧上升。
column4: The chart should show amplitude on the vertical axis.
column5: 这张图表应该在纵轴上显示振幅。

column2: The pitch rises at the end of every sentence.
column3: 每句话结尾的音高都升了上去。
column4: Can we keep the pitch natural when slowing down the voice?
column5: 放慢人声时，我们能让音高保持自然吗？

column2: The music volume is too high during the explanation.
column3: 讲解时，音乐音量太高了。
column4: Check the volume on a phone as well as studio speakers.
column5: 除了监听音箱，也在手机上检查音量。

column2: The input gain was too high during the recording.
column3: 录制时，输入增益太高了。
column4: Can we lower the gain before the signal reaches the effect?
column5: 我们能在信号进入效果器之前降低增益吗？

column2: The peak level is higher in this version of the mix.
column3: 这个混音版本的峰值电平更高。

column5: 我们需要检查录音开头的峰值。
